items.statement: Within the stated model and convergence scope, the selective correction supports a simultaneous improvement of Ge structural, electronic and elastic bulk properties over uncorrected PBE.
items.expected: The final conclusion connects the validated process to multi-property agreement and does not overclaim universality.

items.statement: The interpretation is limited by semiempirical model dependence, pseudopotential/convergence choices and irregular elastic fits near gap changes.
items.expected: Limitations and temperature/model boundary are explicitly stated.
